hero.heading: Villa Azurea
hero.subtitle: An enclave of quiet luxury positioned within the Côte d'Azur
hero.imageAlt: Villa Azurea — Mediterranean estate at dusk
about.title:
A 600 m² oasis
above the Bay of Cannes.
about.lede: Located in Mougins, in the heart of an exclusive private gated community of ten villas including the historic Château de Lérins, Villa Azuréa embodies the French Riviera art of living combined with modern luxury.
about.body1: A rare oasis of peace overlooking the Bay of Cannes, the estate is set on 2.1 hectares of landscaped grounds and offers an exceptional 300-degree panoramic view of the sea and surrounding mountains.
about.body2: Designed as a complex of three buildings — main house, guest house and pool house — the property combines turnkey contemporary interiors with the warmth and craftsmanship of the Provençal tradition.
about.quote: Sea-to-mountain panoramic views, an infinity pool that meets the horizon, and 2.1 hectares of absolute privacy.
about.imageAlt: Aerial view of Villa Azuréa over the Bay of Cannes
estate.label: The Estate
estate.section1.title: Location
estate.section1.body: Perched above the medieval village of Mougins, Villa Azurea commands a privileged position on the Côte d'Azur — fifteen minutes from Cannes, yet completely removed from its noise.
estate.section1.alt: The approach to Villa Azurea through stone gates
estate.section2.title: Architecture
estate.section2.body: The villa strikes a refined balance between classic Provençal form and contemporary restraint — limestone, oak, and glass in quiet dialogue with the landscape that surrounds them.
estate.section3.title: Grounds
estate.section3.body: Over 5,000 square metres of private grounds unfold across terraced gardens, an infinity pool terrace, and an ancient olive grove — nature curated to quiet perfection.
estate.section3.alt: Villa Azurea infinity pool and terrace
estate.section4.title: Interior
estate.section4.body: Each room is a considered composition of natural material and considered light — French oak flooring, limestone walls, and bespoke joinery crafted by artisans from the region.
estate.section5.title: History
estate.section5.body: The site has been inhabited since antiquity. The current structure, built in 2019, honours that continuity — new architecture on ancient ground, designed to outlast generations.
estate.section6.title: Legacy
estate.section6.body: Villa Azurea is not simply a residence — it is an act of custodianship. To own it is to become part of a landscape that has endured for millennia above the Côte d'Azur.
estate.section6.alt: Villa Azurea aerial view at dusk
